judgement.overall_note: The production update captures the main structural new content (user/agent concern distinction, operational-status limitation) and preserves most prior agreements adequately, though with some loss of mechanistic specificity (e.g., _resolve_cadence_hours() detail, per-turn decay granularity). The decision to defer source-verified inspection was also not captured as a key decision.
